description: Get public LinkedIn data via CrustAPI as clean structured JSON. Choose the surface with `type`: profile (a person's full public profile by URL, with work history, education, and skills), company (company details by URL), posts (recent posts from a profile or company URL), jobs (search listings by keywords + optional location, or one job's full detail by URL), or search (find people by keywords; add enrich=true to return each person's full profile). Empty results are free.

comments.description: type=posts: also return per-post comment counts.

employees.description: type=company: also return a sample of employees.

enrich.description: type=search: also fetch each person's full profile (billed per returned full profile).

url.description: A linkedin.com/in/ or /company/ URL (profile, company, posts), or a job URL (jobs).

name: linkedin

jobs.description: Job listings, or one job's detail (type=jobs).

title: Get LinkedIn data (profiles, companies, posts, jobs, people)
